modmenu.descriptionTranslation.goop.en: Adds Splatter Particle Effects for Blood, Slime or other cool VFX
modmenu.descriptionTranslation.goop.zh: 为血液、史莱姆或其他酷炫的视觉效果添加飞溅粒子效果

text.autoconfig.goop.option.fancyGoop.@T.en: Disable for better performance, enable for better goop!
text.autoconfig.goop.option.fancyGoop.@T.zh: 禁用以获得更好的性能，启用以获得更酷的 Goop！

text.autoconfig.goop.option.wrapToEdges..en: Whether Goop should wrap to block edges.
text.autoconfig.goop.option.wrapToEdges..zh: Goop 是否应包裹到方块的边缘。

text.autoconfig.goop.option.randomRot.@T.en: Whether Goop should be rotated randomly.

text.autoconfig.goop.option.censorMature.en: Replaces the colors of Goop VFX marked as mature with the censor Color.
text.autoconfig.goop.option.censorMature.zh: 将标记为成人内容的 Goop VFX 的颜色替换为审查颜色。

text.autoconfig.goop.option.censorMode.@.en: How to censor Mature content, if it is enabled.
text.autoconfig.goop.option.censorMode.@.zh: 如果启用了成人内容审查，如何进行审查。

text.autoconfig.goop.option.permanent.@T.en: Prevents goop from fading. If enabled, goop will only disappear by being unloaded or the Goop Cap being reached.
text.autoconfig.goop.option.permanent.@T.zh: 防止 Goop 褪色。如果启用，Goop 只会在被卸载或达到 Goop 上限时消失。

text.autoconfig.goop.option.goopCap.@Too.en: Limits the amount of Goop Puddles that can exist at a time.
text.autoconfig.goop.option.goopCap.@Too.zh: 限制同时存在的 Goop 水坑数量。

text.autoconfig.goop.option.rainCleaning.en: Washes away Goop Puddles directly under the sky when it rains.
text.autoconfig.goop.option.rainCleaning.zh: 下雨时清洗天空下的 Goop 水坑。

text.autoconfig.goop.option.goopDebug.@T.en: [WARNING] VERY LAGGY | Adds extra particles to show vertex info of goop puddles
text.autoconfig.goop.option.goopDebug.@T.zh: [警告] 非常卡顿 | 添加额外的粒子以显示 Goop 水坑的顶点信息

text.autoconfig.goop.option.showDev.@Too.en: Whether emitters marked as developer content should be visible. (All example emitters are marked as dev content for instance)
text.autoconfig.goop.option.showDev.@Too.zh: 是否显示标记为开发者内容的发射器。（例如，所有示例发射器都标记为开发者内容）
